notes:
Summary: RespondMesh is a mid-market SaaS vendor that powers in-app knowledge search and agent workflows for HR and product teams. They're evaluating a hosted API RAG approach for their customer-facing KB + internal agent. Key constraints: moderate index scale (~1.2M docs, mixed short/longs), very high QPS on peak (2k-4k qps read-heavy), need embeddings + reranking to keep precision high at top-k.

User quotes / call snippets:
- "We need top-3 accuracy close to current vector+BM25 hybrid; false positives cost CS time." (CTO, 3/5)
- "Latency is everything for UX — head queries should be sub-150ms, p95 under 350ms ideally." (Product lead)

Technical wants / requirements:
- Embeddings pipeline: batched re-index every 24h, incremental on doc updates. Dimensionality preference: 1536 or 1024 vectors, considering quantization to cut cost.
- Reranker: cross-encoder stage for top-20 candidates; must run in <50ms median for re-rank step.
- Index size: target 1–1.5M document pieces after chunking. Storage + retrieval cost sensitivity: target <= $0.001/query across both embed+rerank stages.
- Throughput: sustained 2k qps with spikes to 4k; autoscaling needs to be predictable.
- Freshness: near-real-time for urgent docs; typical staleness SLA 5–15m for critical streams.

Security / compliance notes:
- SSO via SAML required; enterprise customers expect audit logs and KMS for keys. Data residency asked for EU customers — they'd prefer Redwood regions in eu-west-1 for EU tenants.

POC status & outcomes so far:
- 3/18 POC: ran 100k-query perf harness against hosted endpoint; baseline (open model + single-thread rerank) gave median 120ms, p95 420ms — good median but p95 over target.
- Observed cost estimate using default batching: ~$0.0025/query; need to get to <=$0.001 with batching, caching, or quantized models.
- Relevance: embeddings-only recall top-10 82%, with reranker uplift to top-3 92% on sample prompt set.

Commercial / buying signals:
- Looking at a Q3 pilot across 10 customers; if POC hits perf & cost targets, ask to move to annual commit.
- AE notes: buyer is motivated, procurement cycles typical 6–8 weeks.

Stated next actions (owner assigned):
- Priya to send updated pricing + batching tradeoff doc (done 3/20).
- Marcus to run dedicated latency tuning run with stronger batching and prefix caching (in flight).
- Security to engage on SAML + KMS checklist; customer will share their compliance matrix (expected 3/28).

CRM shorthand / misc:
- urgency: 7/10, cost-sensitive but willing to pay for lower latency.
- "Need a clear path to p95 350ms and <$0.001/query" — main success metric.
- Drive links added, Fireflies transcripts attached.
